sources.name: Open Trivia Database
sources.changes: Typed-answer adaptations, explicit corrections, aliases, filtering, deduplication and editorial difficulty.

sources.name: TriviaQA reviewed supplement
sources.changes: Individually screened subset with wording, answer, alias and difficulty corrections. Archive difficulty discarded.

sources.name: Original project questions
sources.changes: Original sample recalibrated to Easy/Medium, plus 32 harder originals.

metadata.difficultyStatus: Editorial estimates, not measured success rates; source labels and explicit semantic review, not answer-frequency quartiles.

reviewCoverage.limitations: Editorial screening is not independent primary-source fact verification of all 5,000 questions. Unreviewed source medium/hard records remain provisional.

metadata.aliasPolicy: Whole normalized answers; explicit reviewed variants and equivalent integer number words. Meaningful numeric and language punctuation preserved.
